title: GitHub - dhammon/security-assistant: The Security Assistant is an Ollama based large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) project that summarizes PDF and XLSX documents and responds to customer and auditor security questions. Everything runs locally and does not rely on third party/online models. · GitHub
content:
The Security Assistant is an Ollama based large language model (LLM) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) project that summarizes PDF and XLSX documents and responds to customer and auditor security questions. Everything runs locally and does not rely on third party/online models.
Many organizations are hesitant to provide internal documentation to web based LLMs, such as ChatGPT, because of legal and privacy risks. Therefore, a solution is needed to run a high quality on-premise LLM+RAG that does not rely on a third party to process data. I was inspired to create an LLM that could use existing support documentation to answer security questions customers and/or auditors might have. While the configured prompt is tailored to answering security questions, this project's prompts and files could be easily adjusted to be used for any LLM + RAG purpose.
Langchain unstructured document parsers iterate through each document within the files folder, then chunks the content before inserting it into a local vector database using the nomic-embed-text model.
The agent runs two stages when asked a question using the Ollama3 model. During the first stage, using only the content from the vector database, the agent analyzes available material based on the question and returns a few responses. The second stage uses the output of the first stage to produce a final response.
- Tested on Debian and Ubuntu
- Storage: 25 GB
- CPU: 8 cores, w/o GPU will take ~5 min for LLM to respond
- GPU: optional, but 1000x faster
- Python3, pip, python3-venv (apt install python3-venv )

python3 -m venv env
source env/bin/activate
- Setup environment

Make sure you are in the Python Virtual Environment (source env/bin/activate)
- Upload PDF, XLSX, CSV files to files folder
- Create vector dababase
python3 vector.py
Make sure you are in the Python Virtual Environment (source env/bin/activate)
- Use the agent to ask questions
python3 agent.py
#ask your questions

title: GitHub - unrlight/Lecture-Summarizer-Py: This project simplifies lecture summarization by using Whisper for speech-to-text and the Ollama/Gemini/OAI API for generating detailed summaries in markdown · GitHub
content:
The purpose of the Lecture Summarizer project is to simplify and enhance the process of digesting large educational materials. Transform complex lecture content into concise and accessible summaries. This allows users to save time, focus on key concepts, and make learning more efficient and structured, especially when handling extensive or challenging materials.
| Criterion | LS | 4o | 4o-mini | LS-4o (%) | LS-4o-mini (%) | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Relevance | 0.950 | 0.800 | 0.700 | 18.75% | 35.71% | 
| Coverage | 0.900 | 0.750 | 0.650 | 20.00% | 38.89% | 
| Precision | 0.950 | 0.800 | 0.750 | 18.75% | 21.05% | 
| Consistency | 0.950 | 0.850 | 0.750 | 11.76% | 21.05% | 
| Compression | 0.850 | 0.800 | 0.850 | 6.25% | 0.00% | 
| Understandability | 0.950 | 0.850 | 0.800 | 11.76% | 15.79% | 
The Lecture Summarizer consistently demonstrates better performance than alternative approaches, particularly in delivering high-relevance, precise, and comprehensible summaries. Compared to other methods, it strikes an effective balance between capturing essential details and maintaining clarity, ensuring that the summarized content remains both accurate and easy to follow. For example:
- Relevance: LS ensures that the summaries remain highly focused on the most critical information.
- Coverage: It captures the full scope of the lecture with fewer gaps compared to alternatives.
- Understandability: The summaries are structured and user-friendly, making them more accessible for different audiences.
The evaluation was conducted using DeepEval to ensure consistent and reliable assessment of metrics such as relevance, coverage, precision, consistency, compression, and understandability. Tests focused on lectures of approximately 4,000 tokens (~20 minutes of video) to establish a consistent benchmark.
However, LS showcases its true strengths when applied to longer materials, such as lectures around 80,000 tokens (~2 hours of video). At this scale, its ability to summarize effectively becomes even more apparent, maintaining both relevance and clarity without losing essential information. This capability highlights its suitability for processing extensive educational content, where other methods often struggle to deliver comparable results.
- Summarization of Multiple File Formats: Supports summarization of mp4 ,mp3 ,wav ,pdf ,txt ,srt ,docx , andpptx files without limits on file count.
- Automatic Audio Transcription: Extracts text from audio in mp4 ,mp3 , andwav files.
- Markdown Output: Presents summaries in markdown format, ideal for tools like Obsidian.
- Download Rendered Results: Allows downloading the generated markdown as a PDF file.
- User-Friendly Web Interface: Provides a clean interface with adjustable summarization settings.
- Language Selection: Choose the language for summarization, enhancing accuracy.
- Enhanced Summarization: Perform multiple summarization attempts with automated selection of the best result for improved summaries.
- API Integrations for Summarization:
  - OpenAI API
  - Gemini API
  - Ollama for Local LLMs
- Free Inference Support:
  - GROQ for transcription and summarization
  - Hugging Face for summarization
- Web Page Summarization: Supports summarization of content directly from web pages via URL.
- YouTube Video Summarization: Summarizes YouTube videos directly using their URLs.
- Microsoft Word and PowerPoint Summarization: Processes and summarizes documents in docx andpptx formats.

docker-compose up --build
For future runs, you can simply use:

- You can skip transcription by uploading text files instead of audio/video.
